stack: Vite 6 + React 19 SPA (HashRouter, react-router-dom 7), Tailwind CSS 4, Recharts 3, Supabase (auth + PostgREST + edge functions), Cloudflare Workers static assets

surfaces.name: Tinara partner app
surfaces.layout: Fixed left sidebar, w-64 (256px), dark navy #0f172a, full height; main area ml-64 p-8, h-screen with its own inner scroll. Slim in-page header (page title in uppercase + long date), no top bar. The wizard (/wizard) uses a separate immersive layout with no sidebar: a top row with wordmark, credits pill, optional +250 button and 'Return to Dashboard' (App.tsx:77-169). Demo mode adds a full-screen splash and launcher before the shell (SplashScreen.tsx).

brand.eyebrow: Sidebar section labels: INTELLIGENCE, KNOWLEDGE BASE, ACCOUNT (10px bold uppercase tracking-widest gray-500)
brand.credit_line: 'by REKA' with REKA in orange #fb9800, 10px uppercase, superscript beside the name (Layout.tsx:66). Wizard header: 'Tinara BY REKA' (App.tsx:103). Sign-in: 'Tinara by REKA' and eyebrow 'REKA Intelligence' (AuthScreen.tsx:73, 176). Splash: 'by REKA' and pill 'Strategic Intelligence Platform v2.0' (SplashScreen.tsx:44, 82-85)
brand.other: Browser title 'Tinara by REKA | Strategic Intelligence' (index.html:8); metadata.json name 'Remix: Remix: Remix: Tinara by REKA v1.5'. No version/build text in the shell.

surfaces.responsive: None. No breakpoint classes in Layout.tsx; the 256px sidebar stays fixed at every width and main keeps ml-64, so at 390px the content is squeezed into a ~134px column. No hamburger, drawer or bottom bar. Only the dashboard grid has md/lg column changes. Sign-in collapses correctly: the 70% showcase panel is hidden below lg and the form goes full width.
surfaces.active_state: Active item: bg-plum (#5B2B4A) fill, white text, shadow-lg shadow-plum/20, and a 4px gold (#D6A84F) bar on the left edge. Inactive: gray-400 text, hover bg-white/5 and translate-x-1. Active match is exact pathname equality.

colours.sign_in_panel: plum #5b2b4a with amethyst and gold blur orbs

surfaces.fonts: Inter (body, --font-sans) and Poppins (display, --font-display) from Google Fonts (index.html:11, index.css:4-5). No JetBrains Mono; numbers in KPI tiles use Poppins.
surfaces.a11y: No aria attributes in Layout.tsx. No focus-visible or focus ring styles on nav links or the user menu. User popover has no Escape or outside-click close. No prefers-reduced-motion handling anywhere; fade-in-up, scale-in, pulse, bounce and spin-slow always run. Nav icons are unlabelled SVGs inside labelled links. Route fallback spinners have role=status and sr-only text (App.tsx:44-49).
surfaces.role_variants: Roles are USER and ADMIN (profileFromUser maps is_platform_admin to ADMIN, AuthProvider.tsx:60). Nav items are identical for both. ADMIN gets 'Admin Console' in the user menu and, when the creditTopUp flag is on, a '+250' button in place of 'Top up'. Organisation roles owner/admin/member/viewer are loaded (AuthProvider.tsx:13) but not used in the UI.

brand_gaps: Credit line is 'by REKA' with REKA in orange #fb9800 in the sidebar, wizard header, sign-in and splash; brand kit wants 'Tinara · by AntaraX' in chrome and 'Tinara by AntaraX, from REKA.' on sign-in, and REKA orange removed.
No logo: a plum 'T' letter tile everywhere (sidebar, admin, sign-in, splash). Brand kit logo is 'the signal' (assets/products/tinara/tinara-logo.svg, -small, -light).
Colour: plum #5B2B4A leads with amethyst #8B4E87 gradients and charts; brand kit moves to garnet #7A1E3C (hover #511A2A, tint #FEF4F6) with gold #D6A84F, and retires amethyst.
Dark surfaces #0f172a (sidebar), #0B1120 and #1a0515 (splash) should move to the dark product ground #071233.
Type: Inter for body plus Poppins display; brand kit wants Poppins only and JetBrains Mono tabular figures for scores, credits and counts.

Admin console is called 'Tinara Admin', light and plum, with 'Admin Mode' and 'Control Tower' wording; AXLE standard is 'AXLE · Tinara', dark ground #071233 / raised #0C1B47, REKA orange accent, AntaraX A in the corner, at axle.antarax.ai (until then axle.tinara.antarax.ai), not a route inside the customer app.
Admin dashboard shows fabricated USD figures ($42,500 MRR, $26k Enterprise) and old plan names Starter/Pro/Enterprise even in pilot mode; money should be RM or US$ and plans Seed, Nova, Galaxy.
No Help item in the menu, no /guide or /help, and no help link on sign-in; sign-in says 'Contact your REKA administrator' rather than the support line support@go.antarax.ai.

Words: 'Log Out' should be 'Sign out'; 'Subscription' should be 'Plan' or 'Billing'; 'Users & Access' should use members; roles show as USER and ADMIN in capitals; 'organization' (US) in copy; Title Case and uppercase labels throughout instead of sentence case.

No AntaraX layer: no AI sparkle beside rankings or briefs, no kerawang motif in empty states (the empty chart uses a generic bar icon), no Swell on the sign-in panel (blur orbs instead), no app tile, no legal footer.
Accessibility: no visible focus ring (AntaraX blue #0459F7 required), no reduced-motion handling, no aria on the nav, small 10px gray labels, and no responsive layout at all on either shell.
Prototype naming: 'Strategic Intelligence Platform v2.0', 'REKA Intelligence', 'Tinara Intelligence Engine', 'Initializing Intelligence Core' and metadata 'Remix: Remix: Remix: Tinara by REKA v1.5'.
The org name is never shown and there is no organisation switcher, although memberships are loaded.
notes: Branch build/production-foundation at 02d53b7 (24 Jul 2026). Two runtime modes: demo (VITE_ENABLE_DEMO_MODE, default in dev; bypasses auth, synthetic data, splash and identity switcher) and pilot/production (Supabase auth, AuthScreen, org-scoped credits). All demo captures used the repo's own demo mode; pilot captures used a fake session plus page.route stubs with fictional data, no real backend. Customer shell and admin console share one SPA and one bundle. No existing screenshots in the repo. Recharts is the chart library; icons are inline Heroicons v1 outline paths (stroke 2) at w-5 (customer) and w-4 (admin).
